concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-articles-br-transactions-installments]] - 2026-09-16 Braintree Brazil credit-card installment transaction snapshot covering account-stated default card brands, combo-card account type, 2–12 count and BRL/5-BRL amount constraints, settlement submission and adjustment routes, refund/chargeback effects and detail retrieval; not generic BNPL, current eligibility, a fee schedule or execution/settlement/funding proof, with displayed request-field shapes and non-even remainder behavior left unresolved
